values.note: Fire closure: the FS page's Current Conditions read 'Closed due to Sand Creek and Bobcat Lakes Fires' (page last updated August 31, 2026). No reopening date posted; the campground's normal season ends in September.

status.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/beaverhead-deerlodge/recreation/fourth-july-campground (Current Conditions: 'Closed due to Sand Creek and Bobcat Lakes Fires'; Last updated August 31, 2026), read 2026-10-22

values.note: $15 per night, plus $5 per extra vehicle.

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/beaverhead-deerlodge/recreation/fourth-july-campground ('Single Site: $15 per night', 'There is a $15 per night fee, with an additional fee of $5 for extra vehicles.'), read 2026-10-22

booking.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/beaverhead-deerlodge/recreation/fourth-july-campground (Reservations: 'First come-first served.'; 'There is a 16 day stay limit.'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: 'Open annually from mid-May through September, weather dependent.'
Compacted-gravel sites with paved interior access trails; 30 ft is the maximum RECOMMENDED trailer length.

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/beaverhead-deerlodge/recreation/fourth-july-campground ('the Fourth of July Campground has 6 campsites, made of compacted gravel with paved interior access trails', 'The maximum recommended trailer length for the area is 30 feet.'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Water from a hand pump; ADA accessible restrooms; no garbage service (pack it out). No cell service.

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/beaverhead-deerlodge/recreation/fourth-july-campground ('Water from a hand pump, fire-rings, picnic tables, and ADA accessible restrooms are provided. However, there are no garbage services'; Restrooms 'Vault toilet(s)'; 'Potable water is available at this site.'; 'There is no cell service in this area.'), read 2026-10-22

note: Beaverhead-Deerlodge NF (Wise River RD) campground along the Pioneer Mountains Scenic Byway between Wise River and Polaris, about 12 miles south of MT-43 on FS Road 73; open and sunny. --Claude
summary: FS page (updated Aug 31, 2026) shows the campground CLOSED due to the Sand Creek and Bobcat Lakes Fires (status temporarily_closed, no reopening date). Confirmed $15 + $5 extra vehicle, 6 sites, 30-ft recommended trailer max, 16-day limit. Changed booking (inherited reservable/recreation.gov/180-day window) -> not reservable, FCFS always. Added season (mid-May - September), vault toilets, hand-pump water. Note trimmed of restated values.
